abilities.name: Cold Whisper
abilities.desc: Range 6, Nerve save: 1d8 psychic. Something it used to know, said close to its ear.

abilities.name: Call a Regular
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Echoes, twice per fight: one of the dead regulars pulls up a chair beside you. It flies, it chills, it leaves when you do.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.desc: Spend 1 Echo: haunt an enemy for 3 turns. 1d4 psychic at the start of its turn and -2 to its saves.

abilities.name: Cold Spot
abilities.desc: Spend 1 Echo: the air goes dead in a 3x3 area. Nerve save: 1d6 cold (half on a save) and slowed for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Full Séance
abilities.desc: Spend 4 Echoes, once per fight: join hands. Two dead regulars sit down beside you, and every enemy on the board is haunted for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Possession
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Echoes: lend an enemy to somebody who misses having hands. Nerve save or confused for 2 turns and dazed.

abilities.name: Borrowed Time
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Echoes: the dead lend an ally a little of what they no longer need. Lifts the downed, and 2d6 + Nerve temporary HP.

abilities.name: Grave Chill
abilities.desc: Spend 1 Echo: range 4. 2d6 cold, and you keep half of the warmth it loses.

abilities.name: The Wail
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Echoes: every dead regular screams through you. Enemies within 2 make a Nerve save: 1d6 psychic (half on a save) and frightened for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Mop Handle
abilities.desc: 1d6 + Might and shove 1. The mop has seen worse.

abilities.name: Wet Floor
abilities.desc: Spend 1 Key: mop a 3x3 patch of floor. It costs 3 to cross and slows anyone who stops on it. There is a sign. Nobody reads the sign.

abilities.name: Lock Up
abilities.desc: Spend 1 Key: you know which doors stick. Might save or rooted for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Stack the Chairs
abilities.desc: Stack chairs on an empty tile within 2. Blocks movement and gives half cover.

abilities.name: Closing Time

mod.label: Closing Time: enemies move 2 fewer tiles

abilities.desc: Spend 3 Keys: lock every door in the building. For 2 rounds enemies move 2 fewer tiles, and every enemy within 2 of you is rooted.

abilities.name: Mousetraps
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Keys: set a plus-shaped run of traps on bare floor. Enemies who step in are cut and held. They were not for mice.

abilities.name: Bucket of Something
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Keys: bleach and something else, mixed. 3x3 area, Might save: 2d6 poison (half on a save) and poisoned. Hits friends too.

abilities.name: Sweep
abilities.desc: Sweep a line 3 tiles long: attack every enemy in it for 1d6 + Might and shove them 2.

abilities.name: Shortcut
abilities.desc: Show an ally (or yourself) the service corridor: +3 movement this turn, and moving away provokes nothing.

abilities.name: Deal
abilities.desc: Range 5. 1d6 + Grace. A playing card, flicked very hard, edge first.

abilities.name: Loaded Die
abilities.desc: Spend 1 Chip: the next d20 a hero rolls shows at least 14. Any hero. Choose your moment.

abilities.name: Cold Dice
abilities.desc: Spend 1 Chip: the next d20 an enemy rolls, to hit or to save, shows no more than 6.

abilities.name: Double or Nothing

rows.text: Nothing. The house collects 1d6 from you.

abilities.desc: Range 5, no roll to hit. He tosses a coin for you. Heads: 3d6 force to the target. Tails: you take 1d6.

abilities.name: The House Always Wins

mod.label: The House: heroes roll no lower than 8
The House: enemies roll no higher than 14

abilities.desc: Spend 5 Chips, once per fight: rewrite the dice. For 2 rounds no hero's d20 shows less than 8, and no enemy's shows more than 14.

abilities.name: Cut the Deck
abilities.desc: Spend 1 Chip: swap places with any figure within 5, friend or foe.

abilities.name: Let It Ride
abilities.desc: Spend 3 Chips: an ally's cooldowns all come back, and they add +4 to their next d20.

abilities.name: Spread
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Chips: fan the deck at them. Attack every enemy in a cone for 1d6 + Grace.

abilities.name: Ante Up
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Chips: you and allies within 2 add +4 to your next d20.

abilities.name: Funeral Scythe
abilities.desc: 1d10 + Might. For cutting the grass on graves, mostly.

abilities.name: Keening
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Grief: a sound nobody should make. Enemies within 2, Nerve save: 2d4 psychic (half on a save) and weakened.

abilities.name: Black Veil
abilities.desc: Lower the veil: nothing new can touch you until your next turn (immune to debuffs), and 1d6 + Nerve temporary HP.

abilities.name: Toll the Bell
abilities.desc: The bell tolls for an enemy: marked (+2 to hit it) for 2 turns. Gain 1 Grief.

abilities.name: Funeral Procession
abilities.desc: Spend 6 Grief, once per fight: everyone walks behind you. Downed allies rise at 30% HP, every ally deals +3 damage for 2 turns, and enemies within 2 are frightened.

abilities.name: Open Grave
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Grief: 1d8 + Might, plus a third of the HP you are missing.

abilities.name: Sorrow Shared
abilities.desc: Spend 1 Grief: take 3 of an ally's hurt as your own. They heal 1d8 + Nerve; you lose 3 HP (and grieve it).

abilities.name: Dirge
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Grief: a slow hymn over a 3x3 area. Nerve save or cursed (-3 saves, half healing) and slowed for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Lay a Wreath
abilities.desc: Spend 3 Grief: not yet. An ally heals 2d6 + Nerve (lifting the downed) and regenerates 3 a turn for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Chill Touch
abilities.desc: 1d6 + Nerve cold. A hand on the shoulder from someone who isn't there.
